name: Comitium
tagline: The operating system for the modern homeowners association.
positioning: Comitium gives self-managed HOAs and individual board members enterprise-grade governance, dues collection, and record-keeping in one system.

hero.h1: Run your HOA like an institution, not a group text.
hero.sub: Comitium replaces the shared spreadsheet, the reply-all thread, and the shoebox of receipts with one governed system for dues, records, and board decisions.

features.title: Assessments on autopilot
features.description: Bill dues, apply late fees per your governing documents, and reconcile payments without touching a spreadsheet. Owners pay by card or ACH from a branded portal.

features.title: A defensible record
features.description: Every motion, vote, and violation notice is timestamped and archived. Export a complete, audit-ready ledger the moment counsel or a new treasurer asks.

features.title: Governed communications
features.description: Send annual meeting notices, CC&R amendments, and violation letters with delivery receipts and full retention — no more disputed 'I never got that email.'

features.title: Reserve clarity
features.description: Track your reserve study, funded percentage, and projected shortfalls against real balances so the board budgets on facts, not guesswork.

features.title: Owner self-service
features.description: Homeowners view statements, submit architectural requests, and pay balances themselves — cutting the treasurer's inbox by an order of magnitude.

features.title: Compliant by default
features.description: State-specific templates for notices, quorum rules, and meeting minutes keep small boards inside the lines without a management company.

testimonials.quote: We self-manage 84 townhomes with a three-person board. Comitium ended the annual scramble to reconstruct who paid what. The dues ledger reconciles itself, and our audit took an afternoon instead of a weekend.
testimonials.name: Diane Kessler

testimonials.quote: The violation and architectural-request workflows gave us a paper trail we could actually stand behind when an owner threatened litigation. Everything was timestamped and archived. Case closed in a week.
testimonials.name: Marcus Ferrante

testimonials.quote: I inherited the secretary role with zero context. Comitium had every past meeting minute, notice, and vote in one place. I was running the annual meeting confidently within a month.
testimonials.name: Priya Nadella
